messages.author: e19ea506112fd25b
messages.subject: sflist2stanfit help minor error
parts:
Hi,

I tried to run an example in the sflist2stanfit and experienced one minor error:
 
foo <- stan(model_code = scode, data = foo_data, chains = 1, iter = 0) generates
Error in config_argss(chains = chains, iter = iter, warmup = warmup, thin = thin,  :
  parameter 'iter' should be a positive integer
error in specifying arguments; sampling not done

foo was actually created.

Thank you,
Linas

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] sflist2stanfit help minor error
parts:
I don't think that's an error. You need to run at least
one iteration. "positive integer" means greater than zero.

If all you want to do is compile a model, there's a separate
function for that.

- Bob

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] sflist2stanfit help minor error
parts:
There is a suggestion by CRAN that examples take 5 seconds or less, which is about 1 / 5 of the time we need to compile a model. I agree that it would be better if the word "Error" did not appear but the documentation does say that the stanfit object is created even if there are runtime errors. If you instead source and use

http://mc-stan.org/rstan/stan.R

it suppresses that particular message.

Ben

close the issue.
